October 14, 2022
The General Manager
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited
Stock Exchange Building
Stock Exchange Road
Karachi.
Dear Sir,
We have to inform you that Mr. Huseyin Ozsan Ozbas has tendered his resignation as the Non-
Executive Director of the Company w.e.f. 2022-10-13 and Mr. Oliver Engels has been appointed as
Non-Executive Director of the Company w.e.f. 2022-10-14.
You may please inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Yours Sincerely,
Modeelar
Madeeha Arshad Chaudhry
Company Secretary
PakistanTobacco Company Limited.A Member of the British American TobaccoGroup
